title: 第二十三章 你怎么不去抢周泽破防第24章 掌门不会是想男人了吧女魔头再召见
content_zh:
林陌呆住了，一时间竟有点无从适应。
他严重怀疑，周泽今天出门之前，是不是脑袋被门给夹了。
这不对啊！
尽管周泽说得很情真意切，也拿出了实际行动。
但林陌仍然不相信，周泽会自降身价跟他和解。
不为什么。
只因这里是吃人不吐骨头的魔门宗派初圣宗！
若是在仙道宗派，林陌也许就信了。
林陌将周泽后续塞过来的三百灵石放到了桌面上，直视着他的眼睛：“周管事，你我都不是新来的了，谁也诓不了谁，倒不如直说吧，你想干什么。”
“呵呵，我想的很简单而已，林陌兄弟。”
周泽郑重其事道：“我无意针对你，也对你没有恶意，还请林陌兄弟，今后莫要举报我。”
“另外，以后紫天宫的杂役，还是你来负责，只要你还活着一天，就没人能抢走你的位置。”
“林陌兄弟，你看...？”
林陌慢条斯理地捋着胡须，陷入了沉思。
如果周泽是担心自己举报他的话，那他今日的行为，倒是勉强能够解释得通。
人，毕竟都是自私自利的动物。
义气这种东西，在初圣宗值几颗灵石？
但对于周泽，林陌仍然没有放下戒备心。
说不定他只是感知到，自己的修为比他强了，所以选择跟自己和解。
若自己还是之前那个炼气二重的废物，看周泽弄不弄他就完事了。

说一千道一万，拳头才是这个世界唯一的真理。
“若能图个清静，老夫也不想搞得杂役部鸡飞狗跳。”
林陌收下了那三百颗灵石的补偿，接着道：“至于女杂役，就不用给老夫送过来了，给我换算成灵石折现吧，按照醉仙楼的炼气期算，老夫姑且算你一千灵石好了。”
闻言，周泽的脸顿时黑下来了。
一千灵石，他能买上百个女杂役了！
杂役部的女杂役都是什么货色，林陌清楚，周泽也清楚。
能进入杂役部的女杂役，除了修炼废柴之外，样貌、身材也全都是很普通的。
哪怕没有修炼天赋，只要样貌气质出众，都被初圣宗的高层领回去当侍女了。
见周泽脸色阴沉得几乎可以滴出水来，林陌笑呵呵道：“周管事，一千灵石而已，其他杂役或许拿不出来，但对你来说，应该不算很多，对吧。”
周泽眼皮狠狠地抽搐了一下，一千灵石还不多？
一千灵石他都能雇个金丹期杀手了！
你怎么不去抢？
但考虑到林陌大部分时间都呆在这间小木屋里，周泽也只能作罢。
林陌虽然只是一名杂役，但至少...
在整个初圣宗，还没人敢在紫天宫闹事。
“不...不多。”
周泽咬着牙，只好又掏出一千灵石交给林陌。
他的心都在滴血！
他可以接受花八百灵石跟林陌和解，但一千八灵石...无疑是在割他身上的肉！
可除此之外，周泽也无其他更多办法了。

他要想安安稳稳地在杂役部管事的位置上待着，林陌是一个不可忽视的不稳定分子。
否则，周泽晚上睡觉都睡不安稳。
心满意足地收下灵石，林陌笑吟吟道：“周管事，你不愧是我哥，我打小就看好你。”
“就你这海纳百川一般的肚量和大气，活该你能当杂役部管事！”
content_en:
Lin Mo was stunned, and for a moment he couldn't adapt.
He seriously doubted whether Zhou Ze's head was caught in the door before going out today.
This is wrong!
Although Zhou Ze spoke sincerely, he also took practical actions.
But Lin Mo still didn't believe that Zhou Ze would lower his worth to reconcile with him.
No why.
Just because this is the First Saint Sect of the Demon Sect that eats people without spitting out their bones!
If he were in the Immortal Sect, Lin Mo might have believed it.
Lin Mo put the three hundred spirit stones that Zhou Ze had pushed in on the table and looked directly into his eyes: "Manager Zhou, you and I are not new here. No one can trick anyone. It's better to just tell them what you want to do."
"Haha, what I thought was very simple, brother Lin Mo."
Zhou Ze said solemnly: "I have no intention of targeting you, and I have no malice towards you. I also ask Brother Lin Mo not to report me in the future."
"Besides, from now on, you will be in charge of the handymen of Zitian Palace. As long as you are alive for a day, no one can take your position away."
"Brother Lin Mo, do you think...?"
Lin Mo stroked his beard slowly, lost in thought.
If Zhou Ze was worried that he would report him, then his behavior today could barely be explained.
Humans are, after all, selfish animals.
How many spiritual stones is this kind of loyalty worth in Chu Sheng Sect?
But Lin Mo still didn't let down his guard against Zhou Ze.
Maybe he just sensed that his cultivation was stronger than his, so he chose to reconcile with himself.
If he were still the waste at the second level of Qi Refining before, it would be over if Zhou Ze could not get rid of him.
To put it bluntly, fists are the only truth in this world.
"If we can maintain peace and quiet, I don't want to cause chaos in the handyman department."
Lin Mo accepted the compensation of the three hundred spirit stones, and then said: "As for the female handyman, there is no need to send it to me. Let me convert it into spirit stones and discount them. According to the Qi refining period of Zuixian Tower, I will give you a thousand spirit stones for now."
Hearing this, Zhou Ze's face suddenly darkened.
With one thousand spirit stones, he could buy hundreds of female servants!
Lin Mo knew what the female handymen in the handyman department were, and so did Zhou Ze.
The female handymen who can enter the handyman department are not only useless in training, but also have very ordinary appearance and figure.
Even if you have no talent for cultivation, as long as you have outstanding appearance and temperament, you will be taken back as a maid by the senior officials of the First Saint Sect.
Seeing that Zhou Ze's face was so gloomy that he could almost drip with water, Lin Mo said with a smile: "Manager Zhou, it's just a thousand spirit stones. The other servants may not be able to get it, but for you, it shouldn't be a lot, right."
Zhou Ze's eyelids twitched fiercely. One thousand spirit stones is not enough?
He can hire a golden elixir stage killer for a thousand spirit stones!
Why don't you go and grab it?
But considering that Lin Mo spent most of his time in this cabin, Zhou Ze could only give up.
Although Lin Mo is just a handyman, at least...
In the entire Chu Sheng Sect, no one dared to cause trouble in Zitian Palace.
"No...not much."
Zhou Ze gritted his teeth and had no choice but to take out another thousand spirit stones and hand them to Lin Mo.
His heart is bleeding!
He could accept spending eight hundred spirit stones to reconcile with Lin Mo, but one thousand eight hundred spirit stones... was undoubtedly cutting his flesh!
But other than that, Zhou Ze had no other options.
If he wants to stay safely in his position as the manager of the handyman department, Lin Mo is an unstable element that cannot be ignored.
Otherwise, Zhou Ze would have trouble sleeping at night.
Accepting the spirit stone with satisfaction, Lin Mo said with a smile: "Manager Zhou, you are worthy of being my brother. I have looked after you since I was a child."
"With your magnanimity and magnanimity, you deserve to be in charge of the miscellaneous affairs department!"
